done_when: The image build refreshes Debian security packages after 2026-10-01 and the image scan passes

findings.body: The argument bump invalidates the cached apt layer, but the required image-scan pass has not been demonstrated. The supplied close command runs npm checks and tests without building or scanning the image. The real checks exist at `.github/workflows/image.yml:77` (build) and `:95` (Trivy scan). Run that workflow against this branch and confirm the security-refresh layer executes and the scan passes; npm success cannot establish that the installed libexpat packages resolve the advisories.
findings.title: Not done: The image build refreshes Debian security packages after 2026-10-01 and the image scan passes

why: The image scan fails on new libexpat advisories because the Debian security refresh layer is cached from before the fix
